exact_title: Association of Suboptimal Health Status and Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Urban Chinese Workers
setting_and_sampling_frame: Urban Beijing workers; a random third of 64 companies whose workers attended annual physical examinations for at least two consecutive years at the Physical Examination Center of Beijing Xuanwu Hospital, Capital Medical University; 21 companies selected for cluster sampling.
n_analyzed: 3,019 with complete questionnaire/laboratory data; cortisol Table 2 groups n=1,547 and n=1,472
age_range: 20-60 years eligible; mean 40.6 +/- 13.4 years in the 3,019 analyzed
shs_definition_for_cortisol_comparison: SHSQ-25 sample median score 44; high score >=44 versus low score <44
cortisol_matrix: Serum cortisol as described in abstract, methods and Table 2
fasting_and_sampling_time: Overnight fasting; clock time not reported
assay_and_lab: Gamma radioimmunoassay counter GC-911 in the Endocrinology Institute; intra-assay and inter-assay CV reported as <5.5% and <7.5%; reference 50-280 ng/mL
adjustment_or_classification: Table 2 is a raw high-versus-low group comparison; continuous-score multilevel models are separate adjusted analyses
overlap_signals: Same Xuanwu Hospital/Capital Medical University system as Yan 2015 and Yan 2018; authors Yan, Dong, Liu and Wang overlap; 21 employers are unnamed.
source_locators: Supplied PDF p.1 abstract; pp.2-4 Methods; pp.5-6 Tables 1-2
notes: The unnamed 21-company frame cannot be matched to the three employers named in Yan 2015. No participant IDs or deduplication statement is reported.

exact_title: Association of suboptimal health status with psychosocial stress, plasma cortisol and mRNA expression of glucocorticoid receptor α/β in lymphocyte
setting_and_sampling_frame: Urban Beijing workers from three randomly selected companies whose workers attended annual physical examinations for at least two consecutive years at the physical examination center of Xuanwu Hospital, Capital Medical University.
n_analyzed: 382; high SHS n=193 and low SHS n=189
shs_definition_for_cortisol_comparison: SHSQ-25 sample median score 35; high score >=35 versus low score <35
fasting_and_sampling_time: Overnight fast; 7:30-8:30 a.m.; calm state; waking time recorded
assay_and_lab: Radioimmunoassay in hospital Endocrinology Department; Sino-uk, Shanghai; reference 50-280 ng/mL; PDF reports intra-assay and inter-assay CV as <5.5% and <7.5%
adjustment_or_classification: Table 4 group means adjusted for sex, age, company and waking-to-sampling interval; four cortisol outliers excluded
overlap_signals: Same Xuanwu Hospital/Capital Medical University system and 2012 calendar period as possible Yan 2012 sampling frame; authors Yan, Dong, Liu and Wang overlap.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp.3-5 Methods/Results; p.6 Table 4
notes: The three named employers cannot be matched to the 21 employers in Yan 2012 from the supplied sources. The adjusted means are not equivalent to the raw Yan 2012 Table 2 comparison.

exact_title: Latent class analysis to evaluate performance of plasma cortisol, plasma catecholamines, and SHSQ-25 for early recognition of suboptimal health status
setting_and_sampling_frame: Employees from companies in Xuanwu district attending routine health examinations at the Health Management Center, Xuanwu Hospital, Capital Medical University.
n_analyzed: LCA SHS n=298; LCA health-status n=570
shs_definition_for_cortisol_comparison: Initial SHSQ-25 criterion >=35, but final classes were estimated by LCA using SHSQ-25, cortisol and adrenaline; the final contrast is not cortisol-independent
fasting_and_sampling_time: 10-hour overnight fast; 7:30-8:30 a.m.; 0.5-1 hour acclimatization; seated antecubital draw
assay_and_lab: Commercial radioimmunoassay at Beijing Sino-uk Institute using XH-6020 gamma counter; intra-assay CV <6% and inter-assay CV <10%; reference 50-280 ng/mL
adjustment_or_classification: Diagnostic latent-class classification incorporates cortisol as a manifest variable; not an etiologic SHSQ-25 exposure/outcome contrast
overlap_signals: Same Xuanwu Hospital/Capital Medical University system as Yan 2012 and Yan 2015; authors Yan, Dong and Wang overlap; employers and recruitment period not reported.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp.2-4 Participants/Plasma collection/Results; p.4 Table 2
notes: Because cortisol contributes to final LCA class assignment, the 205.80 versus 161.80 ng/mL contrast is subject to incorporation and should not be pooled with conventional SHS-group cortisol comparisons.
